name: linkedin-jobs-scraper
title: LinkedIn Jobs Scraper - Listings, Salaries & Skills
description: Scrape public LinkedIn job listings by keyword and location: title, company, location, workplace type, job type, seniority, posted date, salary when shown, skills, and apply URL. No login or cookies required.

apify-actor-start.eventDescription: Charged when the Actor starts. Number of events depends on memory (one per GB, minimum one).

job-scraped.eventDescription: Charged once for each job listing successfully scraped to the dataset.
